description: This file defines SCSS mixins for responsive visibility utilities, allowing elements to be shown or hidden across different responsive states via CSS.

methods.name: responsive-visibility
methods.description: A mixin that sets display to block, table, table-row, or table-cell for a given parent selector to control visibility across responsive states.

methods.name: responsive-invisibility
methods.description: A mixin that sets display to none for a given parent selector to hide elements responsively.
